snippet.title: Incoming July 31—See You on the Battlefield!
snippet.description:
The beta test will run from July 3 to July 7, 2025. Don't miss your chance to be among the first on the battlefield.
What roars like a battle hymn? Who bears the torch into the abyss?
What shatters like a falling star? Who charts the course to a new world?
Where the smoke clears, the voyage begins.

Mecharashi officially launches on July 31! Prepare for a new era of tactical warfare!

Beta Test Pre-Registration: https://mecharashi.tentree-games.com/
